# Water availability

Used in [Water](/rules/logistics/30-water).

- **Unlimited sources:** major city, oasis

- **Depleted on:** 1
- **Secret:** yes

## Notes

- Water Points drawn from one well by one draw (SPI 52.13), by source and one die. Cells printed with an asterisk call for a second, secret die: on a 1 the well is depleted (depletion_check / depletion_roll).
- The chart's rows read 'Town' and 'Bir'; the rules (52.11, 52.13) call the first 'village'. We treat 'town' as the village well; major cities are not on the chart.
- Major cities and oases are drawn from without a roll, in unlimited amounts, and never deplete (chart footnote; SPI 52.13, 52.3).
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 108) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p14): 0 of 12 value cells and 0 of 12 asterisks differ. No errata item touches 52.7.
